degree: M.a. in Climate Change, Society and Policy
about:
Curriculum (Research Track) SHrs = Semesterial Hours (AKA as credits)
Mandatory Courses (including Research methods and Practicum): 12 S Hrs
Electives: 11 S Hrs * (At Least 6 S hrs - from electives offered by the program)
Seminars: 4 S Hrs
Thesis workshop: 2 S Hrs
Total number of credits 29 S Hrs
*Students will take two credits (out of the required 11 credits) at the School of Social and Policy Studies
Research Track students are required to complete a total of 29 hours of study and submit a research Thesis. The program is designed to enable students obtain their M.A. degree in no less than 4 semesters: Fall, Spring, Summer; Fall.
Mandatory and elective courses during the Fall and Spring semesters will be taught on Mondays and Thursdays. Elective courses are mostly dedicated courses offered by the program, but can also include courses offered by other international programs in the university that had been approved by the program head.
Deadlines for submitting course / workshop completion papers
Deadlines for submission the paper of the course:
Submission of final papers for courses taught in the first (Fall) semester - March 08, 2026
Submission of final papers for the course taught in the second (Spring) semester – August 16, 2026
Submission of final papers for the course taught in the summer semester – 6 weeks after the last day of the course.
Deadlines for submission seminars' works:
First semester - April 19, 2026
Second semester - September 17, 2026
